policies.draftBanner: DRAFT — this policy is placeholder text and must be reviewed and approved by the business before publication.

shipping.intro: This draft describes how delivery is intended to work for online orders.
shipping.p1: Delivery within Pune is free of charge.
shipping.p2: Orders of {threshold} and above ship free. Orders below {threshold} carry a courier charge (currently shown as {fee}, which is illustrative until confirmed).
shipping.p3: Dispatch times, courier partners and delivery estimates are to be confirmed by the business.
shipping.p4: Orders that need prescription lenses may take longer. Timelines are to be confirmed by the business.

returns.intro: This draft outlines topics the final returns policy should cover.
returns.p1: Which products can be returned or exchanged, and within how many days, is to be confirmed by the business.
returns.p2: Whether custom prescription lenses can be returned is to be confirmed by the business.
returns.p3: Refund method and timelines will depend on the payment provider used by the live store and are to be confirmed.
returns.p4: Customers will be able to contact either store. Contact details are listed on the Contact page.

privacy.intro: This draft explains how personal information is intended to be handled.
privacy.p1: This demo does not send any information to a server. Your bag and wishlist are saved only in your own browser, and form entries are not stored or transmitted.
privacy.p2: The live store will collect the details needed to deliver orders and arrange appointments. What is collected, how long it is kept and who it is shared with (for example payment and courier partners) is to be confirmed.
privacy.p3: This site does not ask for prescriptions or medical details. Any future handling of such information will need a separate, approved policy.
privacy.p4: Privacy questions can be directed to either store using the details on the Contact page.

terms.intro: This draft lists the terms the business will need to finalise.
terms.p1: This website is a demonstration. Products, prices, coupons and availability shown are illustrative and are not offers for sale.
terms.p2: In the live store, prices and stock will be confirmed at checkout by the business's systems.
terms.p3: Appointment requests made in the live store will be subject to confirmation by the chosen store.
terms.p4: THE OPTICAL EXPRESS and Universal Eyecare are independent businesses. This shared website is a proposal pending their approval.

about.title: Neighbourhood opticians, now online
about.lead: {brand} is a proposed shared online experience for two optical stores in Pune: THE OPTICAL EXPRESS in Sahakarnagar and Universal Eyecare near Mitra Mandal Chowk.
about.p1: Both stores help customers find frames that fit well and look right — from everyday eyeglasses to sunglasses and kids' eyewear.
about.p2: This website lets you browse frames, save favourites, request an eye check-up at the store closest to you, and get in touch with either store.
about.p3: The two stores remain independent businesses. The combined brand name shown here is temporary and pending approval.
about.value1: Frames are only as good as how they sit. In-store fitting is part of the service.
about.value3: Two neighbourhood stores, close to home.

about.imageAlt2: Several pairs of glasses resting on books
